newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ATHLETICS-ZOLA GOES FOR HAT-TRICK.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-ZOLA GOES FOR HAT-TRICK.

text.p: South Africa's Zola Pieterse, twice world champion a decade ago, will aim to complete a golden hat-trick in next month's world cross-country championships in Italy.
Pieterse -- Zola Budd when she won the title as a teenager running for Britain in 1984 and 1985 -- was named on Tuesday in the South African squad to contest the event in Turin on March 23.
Pieterse, now 30 with a 15-month-old daughter, practically guaranteed her selection by winning the South African cross-country title in Pretoria last September.
